assertions.name: a new request starts in the master vocabulary
nothing is assessed or executed merely because a request exists
a request made by the principal themselves has self authority
a transition outside the canonical map is refused
a lifecycle state that does not exist is rejected by the contract
the declared first step is permitted
an exact match cannot claim two references
an ambiguous review must actually be ambiguous
a no-match review cannot name matched references
an ambiguous grade is recorded truthfully, not softened
an ambiguous identity cannot begin a disclosing execution
an ambiguous identity cannot receive a disclosure
a later exact review resolves the identity
an established identity may now execute
releasing a response needs its own capability, not merely write access
an already-expired delivery is rejected
redaction review cannot be declined and still release
the response dimension moves without changing the lifecycle state
a response cannot be released twice
an unreachable destination is recorded, not dropped
expected: Offline archive tapes held by facilities
actual: Offline archive tapes held by facilities

assertions.name: unresolved destinations are visible in the scope dimension
entering execution claims nothing until an outcome is recorded
a request with no recorded outcome cannot claim completion
a success on every planned system is still partial while a destination is unreached
a request with unreachable destinations still cannot claim completion
the lifecycle move does not change what the outcomes already said
the recorded outcome names its method and evidence
closure does not rewrite what execution achieved
closure keeps the unresolved destination visible
expected: Offline archive tapes held by facilities
actual: Offline archive tapes held by facilities

assertions.name: closure records why it was closed
assertions.expected: Closed administratively; tape archive remains unreached.
assertions.actual: Closed administratively; tape archive remains unreached.

assertions.name: a closed request is terminal
the database itself refuses to reopen a closed request
the server marks a supported operation automatable
an operation no connector implements is not automatable, whatever was asked for
an outcome cannot be recorded before execution begins
success cannot be claimed without evidence
outstanding work cannot carry evidence
an effect is only unknown after a connector attempt
a connector cannot be credited with an operation it does not implement
an outcome cannot be recorded for a system the plan does not name
outstanding manual work is reported as needing a person
a manual request still cannot claim completion
a recorded outcome cannot be replaced by a second one
the database refuses to rewrite a recorded outcome
a system with a recorded outcome cannot be dropped from the plan
re-scoping cannot discard a system whose outcome was recorded
